There is one supported process. It is **not performed in the Spares screen**, but the Stores transaction steps are the same as the applicable Spares procedure.

1. Open the **Stores** sub-sub-module. This must be done on the Stores screen; do not open Spares.
2. Click **+ Bulk Updates Store** / **Bulk Update Stores**.
3. Select the required category—**Stores, Lubes, Chemicals, or Others**—and the relevant tab—**Inventory, Location, or History**.
4. On the Stores bulk-update page, select **Consume** or **Receive**.
5. Enter the quantities for each location. For **Receive**, enter the received date and place; these fields apply to all rows.
6. Click **Save Updates**, then **Confirm & Save**.

The bulk-update page requires the **PMS admin permission on the server** according to the code-derived guidance; the manuals do not specify a user role. The procedure applies in both Office and Vessel documentation. The Vessel manual resolves it to the Spares procedure in section **1.1.7.6, page 40**; the Office manual resolves it to section **1.1.7.8, page 47**. The screen and permission details are code-derived adaptations rather than quoted manual text.

**Source:**
- Vessel Technical PMS User Manual, section 1.1.8.3, p.43; resolved cross-reference to section 1.1.7.6, p.40.
- Office Sail Admin PMS User Manual, section 1.1.8.3, p.50; resolved cross-reference to section 1.1.7.8, p.47.
